scope: Bounded primary-source audit, own exact control proofs, no exhaustive independent QFT/gravity review.

inspection_legend.FULL_TEXT_TARGETED: Original full text/PDF available and relevant sections inspected; not every line or universal theorem independently checked.
inspection_legend.ABSTRACT_METADATA: Primary author/publisher abstract and metadata inspected; full-text proof not represented as read.
inspection_legend.PRIMARY_SEARCH_EXCERPT: Original-paper search excerpt and publisher metadata inspected; direct full text unavailable.

sources.title: The Theory of Quantum Information
sources.note: Channels, Choi/Kraus/Stinespring correspondence and state discrimination; general theory primary author textbook, not hardware realization.

sources.title: An improved Landauer Principle with finite-size corrections
sources.note: Setup 2.1 and equality theorem; exact finite-bath erasure boundary. Own algebraic proof and priced SWAP control.

sources.title: Fundamental limitations for quantum and nanoscale thermodynamics
sources.note: Thermal operations use Gibbs ancillas and bare-energy-conserving unitaries; own degenerate-Hamiltonian countermodel.

sources.title: The embedding problem for Markov matrices
sources.note: Classical CTMC embedding problem. Determinant and no-jump proofs supplied directly in this package.

sources.title: Quantum generalizations of Bell’s inequality
sources.note: Original quantum Bell bound; operator-square proof reproduced directly, no paywalled full-text claim.

sources.title: Lieb-Robinson bounds and the generation of correlations and topological quantum order
sources.note: Effective cone and correlations under local Hamiltonians; own exact three-spin tail control.

sources.title: Completely positive dynamical semigroups of N-level systems
sources.note: Original CP semigroup generator. Explicit two-level GKLS operator calculation here.

sources.title: Causality, Analyticity and an IR Obstruction to UV Completion
sources.note: Conditional UV analyticity/positivity exclusions; T10 explicitly states its mass-gap/growth/crossing hypotheses.

sources.title: Lectures on Anomalies
sources.note: Gauge/BRST anomaly constraints; elementary chiral U(1) charge sums here, not a full SM anomaly audit.

sources.title: Axioms for Euclidean Green’s functions
sources.note: Publisher abstract and original-paper axioms/theorem search excerpt inspected; direct PDF wrapper failed. Full OS proof not independently reviewed.

sources.title: TASI Lectures on the Conformal Bootstrap
sources.note: Crossing/positivity and conditional numerical bootstrap restrictions; no new numerical bootstrap run.

sources.title: Reciprocal Relations in Irreversible Processes. I.
sources.note: Original reciprocity principle; parity/field-reversal qualifications retained. Not an all-protocol response prediction.

sources.title: Experimental estimation of the dimension of classical and quantum systems
sources.note: Prepare/measure dimensions up to four experimentally witnessed; not this package's exact shift-register implementation.

sources.title: Bulk Locality and Quantum Error Correction in AdS/CFT
sources.note: Specified holographic/code-subspace reconstruction, not an independent universal spacetime selector.

sources.title: Experimental loophole-free violation of a Bell inequality using entangled electron spins separated by 1.3 km
sources.note: Performed Bell experiment; historical benchmark, not October 2026 strongest/latest claim.

sources.title: Single-atom demonstration of quantum Landauer principle
sources.note: Performed ion-based erasure/entropy/environment equality experiment.

sources.title: Demonstration of non-Markovian process characterisation and control on a quantum processor
sources.note: Process characterization and IBM device implementation sections; fixed environment memory remains a comparator. Primary search result exposed the characterization and experimental implementation sections; direct page open failed.

sources.title: Non-local propagation of correlations in long-range interacting quantum systems
sources.note: Performed long-range trapped-ion propagation experiment. Does not violate a correctly applicable short-range theorem.

sources.title: Gravitationally-induced entanglement between two massive particles is sufficient evidence of quantum effects in gravity
sources.note: Proposal; mediator assumptions important. No performed gravity-entanglement experiment inferred.

sources.title: The Entropy Production Fluctuation Theorem and the Nonequilibrium Work Relation for Free Energy Differences
sources.note: Microscopically reversible stochastic forward/reverse protocol restriction; standard Crooks theorem, not new GRUT relation.

sources.title: Invariant Variation Problems
sources.note: Primary Noether text translation; symmetry and variational structure are supplied premises.

sources.title: Quantized Hall Conductance in a Two-Dimensional Periodic Potential
sources.note: Original band/gap topological transport result; no claim all topological or gravitational sectors classified.

sources.title: State-independent experimental test of quantum contextuality
sources.note: Performed trapped-ion experiment. Correct preprint is 0904.1655; 0904.4576 is a different neutron experiment.

sources.title: A Spin Entanglement Witness for Quantum Gravity
sources.note: Proposal only; not a completed experimental lock.

sources.title: Models of Wave-function Collapse, Underlying Theories, and Experimental Tests
sources.note: Primary model review and test framework. No latest parameter bounds or new speculative candidate evaluation.

sources.title: Passive states and KMS states for general quantum systems
sources.note: Complete passivity characterization under the stated dynamical hypotheses; direct DOI open initially failed, publisher endpoint then worked.

sources.title: MICROSCOPE mission: final results of the test of the Equivalence Principle
sources.note: Performed final mission test; historical evidence, not strongest 2026 ranking.

sources.title: Optical clock comparison test of Lorentz symmetry
sources.note: Performed specified optical clock test; coefficient and apparatus assumptions remain.

sources.title: Markovian master equations
sources.note: Davies weak-coupling/rescaled-time Markovian limit, not exact perpetual finite-bath decay.
